finalText:
Builds clean now (exit 0, 0 errors). Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage:

- `src/core/options.js:7` — `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now hands options as `{ retryCount }`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7-11` — `isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined`, but the bumped config loader now leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`. Added an `undefined` → `false` case.

The rest of the noisy output (deprecation warnings, dedupe/tree-shaking notes) is just log noise from the bump and not something to "fix" — it's expected chatter from the new bundler version, not errors.
